example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা বরাহতনয়, কখনো বিশ্বাস করিস না।
এই বরাহতনয়ের কথায় কান দিবি না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's a real son of a pig, never trust him.
Don't listen to that piglet's words.
history: This is a Sanskritized form of the colloquial Bengali insult 'শুয়োরের বাচ্চা', adapting everyday speech into a more formal linguistic structure.
note: Represents a cultural adaptation of animal-based insults common in Bengali vernacular.
